summary: Join our Financial Data Analysis course tailored for policy makers. Learn to interpret data effectively and make informed decisions for impactful policies.
lede: Financial Data Analysis for Policy Makers helps turn budget, revenue, and financial statement data into decision-ready evidence. Participants learn to structure fiscal datasets, forecast revenue and service demand, cost policy options, and assess affordability, value for money, and spending efficiency. Using Medium-Term Expenditure Framework structures and scenario planning, the course develops practical skills for testing assumptions and fiscal risks before implementation. Participants also practise translating findings into clear policy briefs and financially credible recommendations that non-technical stakeholders can understand and defend.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, influence, or defend policy decisions and must interpret financial evidence.
modules: Financial Evidence as a Policy Tool
Translating Policy Questions into Financial Analysis Tasks
Understanding Budget Structures and Financial Statements in Policy Context
Data Readiness for Public Finance Analytics
Descriptive and Diagnostic Analysis for Policy Decisions
Forecasting and Budget Analysis for Policy Planning
Fiscal Impact Analysis and Policy Option Costing
Scenario Planning and Stress-Testing Policy Assumptions
Value for Money and Spending Efficiency Analysis
Financial Risk, Compliance, and Accountability in Policy Implementation
Communicating Financial Findings to Non-Technical Stakeholders
prerequisites: Participants should have basic proficiency in Excel, familiarity with financial and budgetary concepts, and experience in policy-making roles.
